# Tests in this folder are split across multiple manifests. When adding a test,
# please put it in the manifest with its (alphabetical) neighbours.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Manual naming proposal for these mail/calendar browser tests: retain browser_ followed by a concise feature name and .js, such as browser_messageBodyAs.js or browser_threadTreeSelection.js. New descriptive task names in the selection and calendar drag families use test plus a CamelCase behavior, such as testSelectionRestoredOnContextClose or testMonthViewDragEventItem. Existing body-mode tasks use test_email_menubar and similar underscore forms; do not claim the whole tree is already uniform. In the split mail/base browser manifests, register a new test beside its alphabetical neighbors as the manifest instructs. Moving a test to menus or widgets also moves its manifest and support-file context.
title: Match browser test names and registration to the local family
